messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — I noticed keyboard focus jumps to the top of the page when the right-hand filter panel collapses. Happens after hitting the collapse chevron with Enter or Space. Repro steps in a sec. Ollie Park: Repro'd. Steps: open model list -> tab into filter toggle -> press Enter -> panel collapses -> focus lands on topbar search input instead of returning to the toggle. Maya Chen: Here's the minimal repro HTML I used: ```html
...
``` We toggle `aria-expanded` and add `hidden` to panel. Ollie Park: Looks like when we remove the panel from the DOM / set `display:none` we don't move focus back. On some browsers the implicit focus goes to first focusable in document. Ava Rivera (a11y): This is a classic focus-restoration bug. Screen readers (VoiceOver + Safari) announce panel gone but focus landing on search is confusing — user loses context. TalkBack on Android Chrome behaves similarly. Samira Li: UX question: do we want focus to stay inside the filter area (move to the toggle) or be moved to the first meaningful control outside (like apply button elsewhere)? My vote: return to the toggle so keyboard users can toggle it open again. Alex R.: Agreed with Samira. Returning to the toggle is the least surprising. Also we should update the visible focus ring, some users couldn't tell focus moved. Ollie Park: Implementation idea: when collapsing, programmatically call `document.getElementById('filters-toggle').focus()` before removing/hiding the panel. But need to be careful with focus outline suppression on mouse interactions. Ava Rivera (a11y): Ensure you call focus after the DOM change in a non-async way, or use `requestAnimationFrame` fallback for some browsers. Also add `aria-controls="filters-panel"` on the toggle. Avoid moving focus if collapse triggered by clicking outside (mouse) unless appropriate. Maya Chen: Quick patch suggestion: ```js function collapseFilters() { const toggle = document.getElementById('filters-toggle'); // set aria-expanded first so AT sees state change toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); // move focus back to toggle for keyboard-triggered collapse if (lastInteraction === 'keyboard') toggle.focus(); // then hide panel document.getElementById('filters-panel').hidden = true; } ``` We'll wire `lastInteraction` via a small pointer/keyboard listener util. Samira Li: Nice. Also recommend changing label copy to "Filters, collapsed"? Maybe add `aria-live` region that says "Filters closed" for SR users. Short and optional. Ava Rivera (a11y): Prefer an `aria-live="polite"` snackbar message if the collapse is meaningful (e.g., filters applied). For simple open/close I think returning focus + `aria-expanded` is sufficient; extra live text may be noisy. If we do a live region, keep it transient and visually hidden. Design-Bot: Screenshot test added to thread: /uploads/filters-collapse-2026-03-23.png :eyes: (visual focus ring still 1px in dark mode) Alex R.: Dark mode ring issue noted — currently we use `outline: 1px auto -webkit-focus-ring-color` which is faint on our charcoal bg. Suggest `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,122,255,0.25)` for keyboard focus and only show for `:focus-visible` to avoid mouse noise. Ollie Park: Good call. We'll implement `:focus-visible` change and add the `toggle.focus()` fix gated by `lastInteraction === 'keyboard'`. I'll open a small PR and add unit/e2e steps. Maya Chen: Tests to include in PR: keyboard-only collapse flow, mouse collapse flow, VoiceOver quick test steps. Also add a11y note in the component doc. Ava Rivera (a11y): I'll review the PR. Quick checklist for reviewer: - toggle has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` - focus is restored to the toggle for keyboard-triggered collapse - focus-visible ring meets contrast (WCAG 1.4.11) - no noisy aria-live messages on simple open/close Samira Li: Can we add one-line help tooltip on hover: "Collapse filters (keyboard: Enter)" — just to help discoverability. Maya Chen: Ok assigning owners: Ollie for code, Alex for focus styles, Ava for a11y signoff, Samira for copy. ETA: EOD Friday for initial PR. Ollie Park: Opening PR now -> #1234. Will include repro test in Percy as well. :thumbsup: Design-Bot: PR #1234 added to review board and assigned labels: a11y, ux, bug. Maya Chen: Thanks team — will follow up after review.
